about_privacy: No telemetry, no account. History, bookmarks and settings stay on this device. Private tabs leave no history or cache.
address_card_desc: Domain in capitals and page title.
address_centered_desc: A grey capsule with the domain in the middle.
address_full_desc: The whole URL, on one line.
address_hidden_desc: No address: use the Search button or the menu to enter one.
address_plain_desc: Domain and title centered, right on the bar.
address_title_read_desc: The page title and its reading time.
app_icon_footer: The Gold icon is a gift for people who support Qafila. The icon changes on the home screen after a few seconds.
app_icon_footer_all: The icon changes on the home screen after a few seconds.
app_icon_footer_supporter: Thank you for supporting Qafila ♥ The Gold icon is yours. The icon changes on the home screen after a few seconds.
auto_close_footer: At launch, tabs not viewed within this period are closed.
bar_auto_dark_desc: Auto: site color (dark bar if the site is light)
bar_auto_light_desc: Auto: site color (light grey by default)
bar_style_footer: Classic: solid color. Glass: translucent bar. Floating: a rounded bar away from the edges, with the page flowing around it.
comfort_mode_sub: Tab lists anchored at the bottom, near your thumb.
darken_empty: None. “%1$s” in the menu adds an exception for the site.
desktop_empty: None. “%1$s” in the menu switches a specific site.
editor_bar_footer: “%1$s” puts the address in the icon row. Beyond 7 buttons the bar gets crowded. Long-press a toolbar button to open this editor.
editor_menu_footer: Consecutive items without a label form a row of tiles; separators create sections. Closing actions appear in red.
energy_footer: Suspended tabs free their memory and CPU; they reload when you return to them. Background tabs are always paused (animations, videos).
gallery_footer: Tap a bar to use it; you can then fine-tune it in Customize.
gallery_kept: Style, colors and position are kept.
hide_ai_footer: Brave: no AI summary. Google shows its full page (maps and business cards included).
js_off_empty: None. Use the menu to turn JavaScript off site by site.
landscape_top_bar: Bar at the top in landscape
long_press_footer: When tapping opens the menu, long-press edits the address.
menu_empty: Menu empty — add items in Customize.
no_history: No history. Private tabs are never saved here.
no_private_tabs:
No private tabs.
Tap + to open one.
preset_complete_desc: Back, Forward, Share, New tab, Tabs and Menu: the essentials within thumb's reach.
preset_minimal_desc: The address in the row, next to tabs and menu. Nothing else.
preset_navigation_desc: To move from page to page: Back, Forward, Tabs, New tab and Close.
preset_reader_desc: Translate, reader, JavaScript and top of page for long articles.
preset_tools_desc: Reopen closed tab, desktop site and reader one tap away.
preset_zen_desc: New tab, the address, tabs and Close. Long-press the address for the menu.
privacy_footer: Qafila collects nothing and contacts no third-party service besides the sites you visit and your chosen search engine.
private_browsing_note: Private browsing: no history, no cache, no tabs kept.
scroll_hide_desc: The bar slides off screen; it comes back when you scroll up or tap the bottom.
scroll_shrink_desc: Only the domain stays visible; tap it to bring the bar back.
suggestions_footer: Suggestions come from the chosen engine (Kagi, Startpage and Custom: history and bookmarks only).
support_already: You already support Qafila. Thank you ♥
support_none_found: No subscription found for this Google account.
support_open_failed: Couldn't open the payment page: no browser available.
support_pitch: Qafila is free, with no ads and no tracking. For %1$s a month, you help keep it that way — and unlock the exclusive Gold icon.
support_play_unavailable: Google Play is unavailable on this device right now.
support_stripe_pitch: Qafila is free, with no ads and no tracking. If you like, you can help keep it that way with a voluntary contribution through Stripe.
support_stripe_terms: Payment happens on Stripe's secure page, opened in your browser. Qafila never sees your payment details. Your contribution is voluntary and unlocks nothing: everything stays free for everyone.
support_terms: Monthly subscription of %1$s, renewed automatically, cancel anytime from Google Play. Payment is charged to your Google account.
support_unavailable: Purchase unavailable on this device right now.
swipe_address: Swipe the address for Back / Forward
swipe_address_footer: Swipe the address right to go back, left to go forward. The screen edges keep Android's Back gesture, which also returns to the previous page.
tap_address_to_start: Tap the address to get started.
text_size_sample: The wind is rising, we must try to live.
transparency_footer: Adjusts how see-through the toolbar glass is.
